description: Frequency divider with a division ratio of 1 to 21, set by a switch and by voltage; on an oscillator it gives sub octaves, on a clock it gives slower clocks

params.text: Scales the voltage at the CV input before it reaches the division ratio, from -100% at one end through nothing at the centre to +100% at the other
Steps the division ratio through whole numbers from 1 to 21

inputs.text: Voltage that shifts the division ratio, added to the MANUAL setting once the CV knob has scaled it; 10V at full amount covers the whole range
The signal being divided; every edge of it advances the count

outputs.text: The divided signal, switching between -5V and +5V
The divided signal, switching between 0V and 10V

notes: driving this module at audio frequencies is likely to produce aliasing
menu: Legacy Mode — makes the division control divide by 2, 4, 6, 8 and so on, as the original Voltage Controlled Frequency Divider did, for patches built around that module

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
